| | |
|---|---|
| Status | `401 Unauthorized` |
| Type | `https://messagecrate.app/docs/developer/reference/errors/invalid-credentials` |

The username or password did not match an account, the account is disabled, or the current password given to confirm deleting an account or changing the administrator's password was wrong. The server does not say which. A login to a disabled account answers this whether the password was right or not, so a guesser learns nothing. Check both and try again, or ask the administrator whether the account is disabled. The server waits about a second before it answers each refused attempt, so a wrong password costs a moment before the next try. That wait is not protection for a Message Crate reachable from the internet: that is the job of the proxy in front of it.
